Anonymous, forged-session and demo-header requests cannot read admin data
Private files and server modules are outside the public asset allowlist
Cross-origin admin POST is rejected before any mutation

Anonymous Supabase read RPCs receive actual PostgreSQL permission denial
Local assistant health and honest configuration readiness
